notes: Facts the automatic zones cannot read from UW2's levels alone, in the format of uw1-facts.json (see its notes). Every docs/facts/uw2-*.json is read, this file first. The castle plot (X clock 1) is a count in the solver: a fact that grants plotset:V sets it to V, one that grants plotstep:NAME adds one, and plot:N in a requirement asks for the highest set plus the steps to reach N. The levels' own set variable traps are read automatically (the plot's 1, 2 and 3 on levels 3, 9 and 14, the steps of the gems picked up on levels 26 and 48); the steps below come from conversations and the schedules. Not here yet: the end of the plot (13 to 16: the djinn's bottle, the eight gems fused, Nystul's spell), and so no goal.

facts.notes: Talking to Miranda with the castle plot at 3 (set on level 14, the Prison Tower) moves it to 4: the gem then shows three facets.

Altara in Killorn Keep hands over her jewelled dagger (item 10) when first spoken to in earnest, to kill the listener under the castle with. With the dagger held, a timer on level 4 opens the wall at (58, 12) into the listener's lair (trigger #763, inventory trap #764).
Killing the listener (whoami 0x91, in the sewers under the castle) with Altara's dagger adds one to the castle plot; any other weapon leaves it with 1 hit point.
Miranda's news at castle plot 7 ("Well, it seems Nystul had something to say to thee") moves the plot to 8: the gem then shows six facets.
facts.source: conversation 136 (Miranda): the news table's entry 7 runs well_it_seems_nystul, x_clock(1, x_clock(1, 10001) + 1)

facts.notes: The castle plot's schedule moves the plot from 6 to 7 by itself.
facts.source: SCD.ARK block 1, time 6: if X clock 1 is 6, X clock 1 := 7

facts.notes: Meeting Zoranthus for the first time adds one to the castle plot.
The blackrock key gem of Talorus (item 0x11B, gem 4) lies on level 34 at (30, 34).
facts.source: level 34 object #1022; obj/USEITEMS.C UseKeyGem (gem number = item - 0x117)

facts.notes: Nystul treats a key gem when asked (he sets its owner field), and the treated gem used on the large blackrock gem on level 5 fuses with it; fusing gem 4 adds one to the castle plot.

The blackrock key gem of the Ethereal Void (item 0x11F, gem 8) lies on the platform at level 69 (32, 28), twelve steps up among pillars, over a ring of floor walled in all round ((29, 25) to (35, 31)). Karl: awake, Fly or Levitate up beside the platform and take the gem with Telekinesis, or step onto the platform with Portal. Granted in the zone outside the ring, by the gem's facet at (32, 22).

Karl: eat a dream plant and sleep; the dreamer arrives on the gem's platform flying and cannot pocket anything, so he carries the gem to the platform's edge and throws it down into the ring below, where it can be picked up awake once the ring is reached: by the Void's pyramid after the four coloured trials, or with Portal through the ring's wall. Granted in the ring.
facts.source: Karl, 2026-11-13; game/SKILLS.C go_void (the dream arrives at void_tiles[0] = (32, 28), five times in eight; motionbits |= 0x10), inv/INVPANEL.C (nothing goes into the pack while sleepbits and in_void are set), obj/USEITEMS.C UseFood (item 0x114 sets sleepbits)

facts.notes: Karl: there are two djinn bottles. Zoranthus (the Pits, level 58) hands one over once he has been given what he asks for (quest 27), and another whenever asked after that; the second lies in the Void pyramid's room at level 69 (3, 20), which the levels give by its name.

The djinn's capture, the last step: the stoppered bottle (item 0x116, from the Void's yellow room at level 69 (3, 20)) broken on the sigil at level 69 (21, 52) to (22, 53): the air daemon is absorbed, X clock 3 goes to 6 and the castle plot from 13 to 14. Broken before the glaze it kills the player. Counted from plot 13 only: broken earlier, the plot moves to 14 when Patterson dies.

Altara (Killorn Keep) gives a black pearl once the Listener is dead, and with an amethyst rod and a black eggshell brought to her makes the pearl-tipped rod (item 0x112, special spell 0), which cuts the Guardian's lines of power.

The Guardian's line of power of world 1: an invisible Guardian signet ring at level 16 (30, 33), behind the force field at (31, 33); the pearl-tipped rod reaches two squares, so it is used from (32, 33), before the force field.

facts.notes: Karl: the Scintillus Academy's lava room (level 43) is crossed by jumping from pillar to pillar, with the pillars raised and lowered by the six buttons on the side walls, which the level's telekinesis wand presses from afar; nothing else is needed, and falling into the lava is failing the puzzle, not a way. The pillars are a 5 by 3 grid three squares apart from (27, 34), toggled between heights 2 and 10 (hack 20); the way runs from the ledge at (33, 31) over the middle column to the passage at (33, 43).
facts.source: Karl, 2026-11-14; event/WORLDEV.C toggle_pillars_hack; level 43 buttons #1018 to #1023, hack traps #999 to #1009
